title: Restriction between two opens on fixed-resolution section homology
statement: Let Z be a scheme, F an O_Z-module, I an injective resolution, L <= U opens and R,R prime augmentation-preserving restricted-resolution section identifications over U,L as in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Let j:L -> U be their inclusion. The coefficient map is the j-restriction adjunction unit on F restricted to U followed by pushforward of the canonical restriction-composition isomorphism identifying j^*(F|U) with F|L. Let res be its cohomology map of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Let i_R and i_Rprime be the respective derived-global-sections resolution isomorphisms, followed by the inverse exact-forgetful homology comparison [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-map-via-lift]. Let r:I(U) -> I(L) be termwise section restriction. Then res followed by i_Rprime and H^p(R prime.sections) equals i_R followed by H^p(R.sections) and H^p(r), for every natural degree p. This is an equality of additive morphisms before evaluation homology, theta, pushforward or higher-direct-image normalization. No affineness, quasi-coherence or positivity of p is assumed.

source.place: Remark 20.14.2 (cohomology-remark-functoriality), specialized to open inclusion with identity injective comparison; restriction map in Equation 20.7.1.1 (01E2), constructed by Lemma 20.7.1 (01E1).

proof.text: Put j = homOfLE e and c = restrictFunctorComp(j,U.ι) inverse followed by restrictFunctorCongr(j≫U.ι=L.ι). Define t by restricting R.comparison.hom along j, composing with c on I, and then R prime.comparison.inv. Define beta as the restriction unit on R.resolution followed by pushforward of t. The augmentation equations and naturality of c and the unit prove that beta lifts the stated coefficient map.

Construct the canonical sections isomorphism a from sections on L to sections on U of the pushed target resolution; its inverse components are restriction along j inverse top = top. Apply moduleCohomologyFMap_of_augmentedLift to beta, its augmentation equation, and a. This computes the cohomology map using the given resolutions, with no assumption that pushforward preserves injectives.

Prove the chain-map equality Gamma_U(beta) followed by a inverse and R prime.sections.hom equals R.sections.hom followed by termwise restriction of I sections from U to L. In each degree expand the pinned section components, move the inverse target comparison past restriction by naturality and cancel it, then move the source comparison past the restriction unit by naturality. Expand the unit and restriction-composition component formulas. All remaining arrows are maps of the same presheaf along inclusions; combine them by functoriality and use uniqueness of morphisms between opens. This is a complete Lean calculation, independent of injectivity and valid for empty or equal opens.

Apply the homology functor to the chain-map equality. Substitute the augmented-lift formula and cancel the target resolution comparison with its inverse. Functor.map_comp and associativity yield the asserted identity in every natural degree.

proof_origin.place: Remark 20.14.2, using the existing fixed augmented-lift theorem; restriction components as in Equation 20.7.1.1 (Tag 01E2). The degreewise section calculation and homology cancellation are proved in Lean.

theorem restrictedResolution_open_cohomology {Z : Scheme.{u}} {F : Z.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (U L : Z.Opens) (e : L ≤ U)
    (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I U) (R' : RestrictedResolutionSections I L)
    (p : ℕ) :
    let := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive Z.toRingedSpace
    let := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
    let := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive L.toScheme.toRingedSpace
    let j := Z.homOfLE e
    let c := (restrictFunctorComp j U.ι).symm.app F ≪≫
      (restrictFunctorCongr (Z.homOfLE_ι e)).app F
    moduleCohomologyFMap j
      ((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F) ≫
        (pushforward j).map c.hom) p ≫
      (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        (R'.resolution.isoRightDerivedObj
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor L.toScheme.toRingedSpace) p).hom ≫
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex R'.resolution).sc p).mapHomologyIso
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
        R'.sections.hom =
    (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      (R.resolution.isoRightDerivedObj
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) p).hom ≫
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex R.resolution).sc p).mapHomologyIso
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
      R.sections.hom ≫
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
          (Functor.whiskerLeft (SheafOfModules.forget Z.ringCatSheaf ⋙
            PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Z.ringCatSheaf.obj)
              ((evaluation Z.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
                (homOfLE e).op))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).app I.cocomplex)
